brown.$description: Bot avatar colour 'brown', swatch 2 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

red.$description: Bot avatar colour 'red', swatch 3 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

orange.$description: Bot avatar colour 'orange', swatch 4 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

amber.$description: Bot avatar colour 'amber', swatch 5 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

green.$description: Bot avatar colour 'green', swatch 6 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

teal.$description: Bot avatar colour 'teal', swatch 7 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

blue.$description: Bot avatar colour 'blue', swatch 8 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

purple.$description: Bot avatar colour 'purple', swatch 9 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

pink.$description: Bot avatar colour 'pink', swatch 10 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

gray.$description: Bot avatar colour 'gray', swatch 11 of the Create New Bot palette. The same value in both themes. A bot's avatar, its switches (darkened) and its group-avatar stack use it.

000.$description: Used by: dark text.primary (Sampled (text)), light surface.card (Sampled).

200.$description: Used by: light surface.bubble (Sampled), light surface.bubbleDirectLight (Sampled).

1050.$description: Used by: dark surface.card (Sampled), dark surface.chip (Sampled).

card.$description: Grouped cards in settings and on the bot profile, and single-line fields. Diagonal-inset readings: settings card 13.7pt dark, 15.4pt light; profile card 11.9pt dark, 15.4pt light; name field 13.7pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

field.$description: Single-line and multi-line fields share the card radius (text area reads 13.7pt).

bubble.$description: Message bubble, first or only bubble from a sender: 20.5pt in both themes, and the owner's bubble 20.5pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

bubbleJoined.$description: The top corners of a bubble that follows another from the same sender: 8.5pt. Plus or minus 2 pt.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet: 35.8pt dark, 37.6pt light.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: buttons (22.2pt on a 42 pt button), chips (11.9pt on 25 pt), the 'Added' button (17.1pt on 34 pt), the composer (22.2pt on 48 pt), the Edit pill, glass nav buttons and the search bar.

base.$description: Every measured gap is a multiple of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Gap between a home-grid avatar and its label, and inside chips.

sm.$description: Gap between stacked bubbles from one sender (about 9 pt edge to edge in dark/07-chat-bubbles).

md.$description: Padding above the first line of a bubble and between composer controls.

lg.$description: Screen margin: settings cards start 16 pt from the screen edge (rim included), bubbles 16.5 pt.

xl.$description: Bot profile cards' side margin (24 pt) and the gap between grouped cards on that page (24 pt, rows.profile).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, bubbles and the home grid.

row.$description: Single-line grouped row (bot profile rows, settings rows), divider to divider.

rowTwoLine.$description: Grouped row with a subtitle (Connect apps, Auto-review): about 70 pt in dark/19-account-menu.

navButton.$description: Round glass back, close and more buttons (a circle). The reading includes the glass rim's soft edge; the touch target is at least this.

searchBar.$description: Height of the home search bar (glass capsule).

composer.$description: Height of the composer field (glass capsule).

composerButton.$description: The round + button beside the composer.

width.$description: Send and voice buttons inside the composer: a pill, not a circle.

height.$description: Send and voice buttons inside the composer.

button.$description: Full-width primary button (Create, Send Feedback): 315x41.5pt in dark.

field.$description: Single-line field height: 343x54pt dark (rim included), 341x52pt light.

secondaryButton.$description: Inline Add or Added button in a list row: 68x34pt.

swatch.$description: Colour swatch in the avatar picker.

avatarGrid.$description: Home-grid bot avatar. The shapes differ, so their boxes do: 86x77.5pt (heart), 95x91pt (star).

menuWidth.$description: Pull-down menu width (248.5pt); two items make it 104pt tall.

bubbleMaxWidth.$description: The widest one-to-one bubble (314x84pt), 16 pt from the left edge. Group bubbles sit after a 24 pt avatar column and reach 287 pt.

touchTarget.$description: The nav buttons, rows and composer controls are 44 pt or more. Chips (25 pt), the Edit pill and the send pill (32 pt) are smaller and sit inside larger rows or fields.

hairline.$description: Dividers between grouped rows: one device pixel at 2x (border.dividerColour reads a one-pixel row).

rim.$description: The rim around grouped cards and fields (border.card), one device pixel.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are a neo-grotesque close to the iOS system face; use the platform font.

regular.$description: Body text, settings rows, previews. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Home row titles and nav titles. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: The bot name on its profile and the primary button label. Judged by stroke width.

titleLarge.$description: The bot's name on its profile. Cap-height readings: 22pt.

fieldLarge.$description: Text typed into the Create New Bot name field, centred. Cap-height readings: 22pt.

body.$description: Bubble text, settings rows, sheet titles, empty-state lines. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

rowTitle.$description: Home list row titles and nav bar titles. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

callout.$description: Composer placeholder, menu items, the unread pill. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

preview.$description: Home row preview line and folder names. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

subheadline.$description: Row subtitles, home-grid labels, section headers, thread system lines, the 'Added' label. Cap-height readings: 14pt.

footnote.$description: Helper text under cards, row timestamps. Cap-height readings: 13pt.

caption.$description: Sender label above a group bubble. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, menus, the composer, the search bar): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: none drawn; separation comes from fills, rims and the glass material
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: Home, chat threads and search results.

sheet.$description: Sheets (Settings, Create New Bot) and pushed detail pages (Routines, bot profile, Usage).

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the home screen reads #FCFCFC undimmed and #CACACA under a context menu (a sheet dims it to #C8C8C8).

card.$description: Grouped cards, single-line fields and the text area.

field.$description: Single-line field fill; the same value as the card.

bubble.$description: Bot message bubble in a group chat. The box's dominant colour covers 87% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bubbleDirect.$description: Bot message bubble in a one-to-one chat.

ownBubble.$description: The owner's own message bubble: the bot's avatar colour darkened to about 77% (amber #FF9700 gives #C37300), the same rule as switch.onBot. Not captured in light: the bubble follows the bot colour, and switch.onBot, made by the same rule, reads the same in both themes, so the dark value is used.

code.$description: Code block inside a bot bubble, with a copy button at its top right. Not captured in light: filled from surface.secondary, the closest light role.

secondary.$description: Chips and inline secondary buttons (Added, Add).

tertiary.$description: The Edit pill on a bot profile.

glass.$description: Glass controls (composer field, nav buttons, search bar), centre reading. The material tints with whatever is behind it. The box's dominant colour covers 33% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

menu.$description: Pull-down and context menus (glass). The reading picks up the avatars behind the menu. The box's dominant colour covers 27% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

divider.$description: Hairline between grouped rows, inset to the row text.

card.$description: Rim around grouped cards and fields: lighter than the card in dark, darker in light. The box's dominant colour covers 50% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

primary.$description: Titles, row titles, bubble text, settings labels.

secondary.$description: Previews, grid labels, row values and subtitles, sender labels. Readings in this role range #88888C, #89888B, #89898A, #8A898E, #8A8A8C, #8B8B8E.

tertiary.$description: Timestamps, section headers, folder counts, helper text, field labels. Readings range #BEBEBF, #BEBEC0, #BFBFBF, #C1C1C1, #C1C1C3, #C3C3C4.

disabled.$description: Label of a disabled inline button (Added).

onOwnBubble.$description: Text on the owner's coloured bubble. Not captured in light: the dark value is used, as for surface.ownBubble.

code.$description: Monospace text in a code block. Not captured in light: filled from text.secondary, the closest light role.

link.$description: Inline links in bubbles (with a cube icon for internal objects).

onAccent.$description: Label on the blue unread pill.

danger.$description: Destructive menu items (Delete, Hide) and Sign Out: red text, never a red fill.

default.$description: Unread dots and the update dot. The app's only system accent; a bot's own colour takes over its switches.

pill.$description: The floating 'N unread' pill (glass over blue). The box's dominant colour covers 60% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused field: the only focus indicator (no ring). The box's dominant colour covers 28% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

bg.$description: Full-width primary button, enabled: white in dark, near-black in light.
Primary button, disabled (glass). The box's dominant colour covers 53% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.
Inline secondary button (Add): the secondary surface.
Send and voice pills inside the composer: the inverse of the theme.

glyph.$description: Arrow and waveform glyphs on them.

on.$description: Switch on, app-wide settings (Auto-review, time zone).

onBot.$description: Switch on, on a bot's own pages: the bot's avatar colour darkened to about 77% (purple #9158FE gives #6F44C3). Settings > Appearance > Bot color turns this on.

ink.$description: First swatch of the avatar palette: the theme's ink (white in dark, black in light).

eye.$description: A bot's eyes are cut-outs that show the page colour.

star.$description: Star badge on a pinned bot: the amber avatar colour. The box's dominant colour covers 67% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

success.$description: Success: the connected-account tick. No success fill or border was seen.

danger.$description: Danger: red text on destructive items. No danger fill was seen.

info.$description: Info: the blue accent (unread, update available).

notTokenised: Warning colour: no warning state was seen
Per-bot accent: every bot's switches take its own avatar colour; only the purple bot's was read
